fields.label: Language
fields.description: BCP-47 language tag of the language being taught, e.g. "pt-BR", "fr", "de".

fields.label: Instruction Language
fields.description: Language the on-screen instructions/labels are written in. Leave unset to use the target language.

fields.label: Estimated Minutes
fields.description: Minutes the exercise is expected to take.

fields.label: Teacher Notes
fields.description: Shown to the student after they submit, regardless of score.

fields.label: Variant Group
fields.description: Give the same id to two or more pages (usually the same exercise in different languages) to offer them as "Try in other language" swaps on each other. Only one member of the group appears in the sidebar.

fields.label: Menu Label
fields.description: Label shown in the sidebar menu. Falls back to a generic name for the exercise type, then to Title, when unset.

fields.label: Word Bank
fields.description: Optional shuffled bank of options shown above the text, e.g. so students pick rather than recall freely.

fields.label: Matching
fields.description: Fine-tune how a typed answer is matched (case, accents, punctuation, script-specific folding). Leave unset to use sensible defaults for the exercise language.

properties.label: Case Sensitive
properties.description: Require the exact same upper/lower case as the stored answer.

properties.label: Accent Sensitive
properties.description: Latin scripts only: when off (default), "cafe" matches "café". Has no effect on scripts where marks form distinct letters (Cyrillic й/ё, etc.).

properties.label: Punctuation Sensitive
properties.description: Require the exact same punctuation as the stored answer.

properties.label: Script
properties.description: Overrides the writing system auto-detected from `language`. Only set this if the exercise language is misdetected.

properties.label: Fold Width
properties.description: CJK only: treat full-width and half-width forms as equal (ﾃｽﾄ = テスト). On by default.

properties.label: Fold Kana
properties.description: Japanese only: treat katakana and hiragana as equal (ト = と). Off by default.

properties.label: Fold Yo
properties.description: Russian only: treat ё and е as equal. Off by default, since they are technically distinct letters.

properties.label: Strip Harakat
properties.description: Arabic only: ignore harakat/tashkeel vowel marks, which students usually omit when typing. On by default.

properties.label: Fold Alef
properties.description: Arabic only: treat alef variants, taa marbuta, and alef maqsura as their base letter (أإآ→ا, ة→ه, ى→ي). Off by default.

properties.label: Strip Niqqud
properties.description: Hebrew only: ignore niqqud vowel points, which students usually omit when typing. On by default.

properties.label: Text
properties.description: Use `___` (3 or more underscores) to mark each blank.

properties.label: Answers
properties.description: One or more accepted answers for this item's blank(s), in the order the blanks appear.

variantGroup.description: Give the same id to two or more pages (usually the same exercise in different languages) to offer them as "Try in other language" swaps on each other. Only one member of the group appears in the sidebar.

menuLabel.description: Label shown in the sidebar menu. Falls back to a generic name for the exercise type, then to Title, when unset.

info.description: The reference material (schedule, notice, etc., written as Markdown) the student reads before the questions begin, and can refer back to throughout.

readingSeconds.description: Seconds given to read the reference material before the first question begins.

questions.description: One or more short spoken questions, asked and answered in sequence.

promptAudio.description: The spoken question the student responds to.

src.description: Path to the file under `public/media/`, e.g. "/media/example.mp3" or "/media/example.svg".

alt.description: Shown to screen readers and used as a fallback caption.

credit.description: Optional attribution shown under the image/audio, e.g. for a photo's source.

correctAnswer.description: The expected short spoken answer, auto-scored against what speech recognition hears (see autoScore).

preparationSeconds.description: Seconds the student silently prepares before recording starts automatically.

answerSeconds.description: Seconds allowed to record an answer; recording stops automatically once this runs out.

plays.description: Total times this question's audio plays before preparation begins. The last question in a set is often heard twice; earlier ones usually once.

autoScore.description: Auto-score using the browser's speech recognition where available, checked against correctAnswer/target.

matching.description: Fine-tune how a typed answer is matched (case, accents, punctuation, script-specific folding). Leave unset to use sensible defaults for the exercise language.

caseSensitive.description: Require the exact same upper/lower case as the stored answer.

accentSensitive.description: Latin scripts only: when off (default), "cafe" matches "café". Has no effect on scripts where marks form distinct letters (Cyrillic й/ё, etc.).

punctuationSensitive.description: Require the exact same punctuation as the stored answer.

script.description: Overrides the writing system auto-detected from `language`. Only set this if the exercise language is misdetected.

foldWidth.description: CJK only: treat full-width and half-width forms as equal (ﾃｽﾄ = テスト). On by default.

foldKana.description: Japanese only: treat katakana and hiragana as equal (ト = と). Off by default.

foldYo.description: Russian only: treat ё and е as equal. Off by default, since they are technically distinct letters.

stripHarakat.description: Arabic only: ignore harakat/tashkeel vowel marks, which students usually omit when typing. On by default.

foldAlef.description: Arabic only: treat alef variants, taa marbuta, and alef maqsura as their base letter (أإآ→ا, ة→ه, ى→ي). Off by default.

stripNiqqud.description: Hebrew only: ignore niqqud vowel points, which students usually omit when typing. On by default.
